coreAction.what: Search multiple keyword channels and return source URLs

install.command: uv sync --python 3.12 --extra mcp && uv run research-mcp --help

G1.reason: User delegated noninteractive decisions; adapts the original concrete promise and names results/source text. Higher word budget preserves mandatory R2–R4 tables and limits.

G2.choice: Approve compact, collapsible MCP first screen
G2.reason: Inspected desktop light/dark, mobile and bilingual artwork. Reduced a sparse overlong first artwork after density/installation-fold failure. Entire install/search/read block is visible; one first-screen disclosure contains all three config snippets. Full expanded snippets cannot all fit an 800px fold; this limitation is disclosed. Same offline local renderer before and after.
